passages.text:
<line> MOLD?!?
<line> IN THE SAFE?!?
<line> .... am i ... seeing things?
<line> do i have some kind of mold poisoning?
<line> the manager couldn't have possibly been right about the roaches, or...
[[((...))]]
passages.name: Start

passages.text:
<cluegiven> EndSeq8.2
<line> AND SHE'S GOING TO PAY!!!
<line> this apartment is disgusting!! and dangerous!! the mold and roaches shouldn't even be my responsibility! it's on the landlord
<line> and the mold... it's spreading...
<line> i can't believe she keeps threatening me with something THEY'RE supposed to take care of!
<line> i'm going to the office one last time...
<line> i'm not letting emily down!
passages.name: the guns are real, the mold is real, and the manager is evil

passages.text:
<cluegiven> EndSeq8.2
<line> the mold must be why i'm seeing roaches with GUNS
<line> i mean if they were real, i would be dead by now right?
<line> ha... ha?
<line> and it's spreading...
<line> i mean maybe i have an allergy... like emily's...
<line> i'm going to management one last time. i KNOW they'll take care of mold.. right?
passages.name: no. it's not real. i'm actually going insane

passages.text:
<line> ... the roach guns... is that even real?
<line> what will emily think of all of this?
<line> ... or ... did the manager do this?
<line> what do i have to do to keep my family safe?
[[the guns are real, the mold is real, and the manager is evil]]
[[no. it's not real. i'm actually going insane]]
